Name: Brightness preview
Description: Apply the game's brightness adjustment once. The current renderer value is shown here; later game settings can replace this preview.
RestoreBehavior: One-time display preview. Disconnect leaves the completed preview in place. Restore loaded display settings reapplies the game's loaded configuration. Profile application issues this action once.

Evidence.Finding: The native menu limits signed brightness to -50..50; preview writes GX+716 and gamma2.2/(2.2+level/50). The final pass consumes these constants.
Evidence.Level: Full native IDA assembly and synthetic lifecycle/ABI/locking tests. Live display validation is pending.

Name: Restore loaded display settings
Description: Reapply the currently loaded brightness and color-vision settings to the renderer. The action reads one validated snapshot of the game settings.
RestoreBehavior: Applies both native preview functions once under the presentation mutex. Configuration and save files remain unchanged. Later game settings can replace the result.

Evidence.Finding: Loaded signed16 settings reside at fields+12,+16,+18. Their validated immutable snapshot can be reapplied with the native preview wrappers without entering the settings-save state machine.
Evidence.Level: Full native IDA assembly and synthetic restore/fault tests. Live display validation is pending.

Name: Color-vision preview
Description: Apply one native color-vision mode and strength. Mode 0 disables the correction. Modes 1 to 3 use the game's existing correction matrices.
RestoreBehavior: One-time paired preview under the presentation mutex. Mode 0 applies native severity 0. Disconnect leaves the completed preview in place; Restore loaded display settings reapplies the game's loaded values.

Evidence.Finding: Native menu bounds type0..3 and severity1..10; the preview normalizes disabled mode to(0,0) and updates the final-pass color-vision constants.
Evidence.Level: Full native IDA assembly and all40 supported mode/severity pairs tested in isolation. Live display validation is pending.
